meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML. Use this whenever the user wants WeChat article formatting, article preview, WeChat draft upload, image generation for articles, cover or infographic generation, image-post creation, writer-style drafting, title suggestions, AI trace removal, or current discovery of supported providers, themes, prompts, and layout modules. Also use for unpublished Zhihu, CSDN, Toutiao, or Tencent Cloud Developer Community drafts through a browser. Use for product introductions, encyclopedia articles or entry drafts, and writing tailored to platforms or search targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 原稿排成公众号图文,自动配图并存入草稿箱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常写公众号,想把 Markdown 稿快速变成可直接发布的图文。
copy.tagline_en: Format Markdown into WeChat posts, add images, and save a ready draft
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write for WeChat and want Markdown turned into publish-ready posts.

howto.what: Claude 会调用 md2wechat 命令行,把 Markdown 文章转成微信公众号 HTML,并可按需预览、生成封面或信息图、做图片帖、给标题建议、去 AI 痕迹;只有你明确要求时才上传图片或创建草稿。
howto.when: 当你需要微信文章排版、封面或信息图生成,或要把 Markdown 转成公众号 HTML 时触发;也用于知乎、CSDN 等平台的未发布草稿。

say.text: 把这篇 article.md 转成公众号 HTML,先给我预览
say.note: 先跑 inspect 与 preview,不做上传或草稿

say.text: 给这篇文章生成几个微信标题建议
say.note: 只输出标题候选,不写回原文

say.text: 帮我给这篇文章做一张封面图
say.note: 有可用预设时优先走 generate_cover

howto.what_en: Claude runs the md2wechat CLI to convert Markdown into WeChat article HTML, preview it, generate covers or infographics, build image posts, suggest titles, and strip AI traces; it uploads images or creates drafts only when you ask.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need WeChat article formatting, a cover or infographic, or Markdown-to-WeChat HTML, and for unpublished Zhihu or CSDN drafts.

say_en.text: Convert article.md to WeChat HTML and show me a preview first
say_en.note: Runs inspect and preview; no upload or draft

say_en.text: Suggest some WeChat titles for this article
say_en.note: Emits title candidates only; no write-back

say_en.text: Make a cover image for this article
say_en.note: Prefers generate_cover when a preset fits
